en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Muhammad Bin Uzafar, from umar Bin Yazeed who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Beware of the discolouration of the dyeing, for in that is despair’.
en.sarwar: 11. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from Muhammad ibn ‘Adhafir from ‘Umar ibn Yazid who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘You must not allow the hair dye to wear off because it is despair.’”
